title: TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE REPORT relative to prohibiting the parking of vehicles that are in excess of 22 feet in length or over 84 inches in height, during…
text:
[Council File 26-0008-S18; CD 2]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE REPORT relative to prohibiting the parking of vehicles that are in excess of 22 feet in length or over 84 inches in height, during the hours of 2:00 am and 6:00 am along certain street segments, pursuant to Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC) Section 80.69.4, in Council District Two.
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Resolution (Nazarian – Rodriguez):
PROHIBIT, pursuant to LAMC Section 80.69.4, the parking of vehicles that are in excess of 22 feet in length or over 84 inches in height, during the hours of 2:00 am and 6:00 am along the following street segments:
Both sides of Vantage Avenue between Roscoe Boulevard and Stagg Street
Both sides of Vineland Avenue between Bluffside Drive to Acama Street
Both sides of Ethel Avenue between Raymer Street and Sherman Way
Both sides of Gilmore Street between Wilkinson Avenue and Rhodes Avenue
Both sides of Rhodes Avenue between Kittridge Street and Gilmore Street
Both sides of Camellia Avenue between Vanowen Street and Archwood Street
Both sides of Vineland Avenue between Chandler Boulevard and Burbank Boulevard
Both sides of Craner Avenue between Oxnard Street and Califa Street
Both sides of Cleon Avenue between Oxnard Street and Califa Street
Both sides of Califa Street between Craner Avenue and Cleon Avenue
DIRECT the Los Angeles Department of Transportation (LADOT), upon the adoption of this Resolution, to post signs giving notice of a “tow away, no parking” restriction for oversized vehicles, with the specific hours detailed, at the above locations.
AUTHORIZE the LADOT to make technical corrections or clarifications to the above instructions in order to effectuate the intent of this Resolution.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Resolution to bar parking of vehicles longer than 22 feet or taller than 84 inches from 2:00 to 6:00 a.m. on specified street segments in Council District 2.
